payload.title: A1 · Een afspraak maken
payload.patternExplanation: Use Ik wil graag… to make a polite request. The verb stays in its normal position after ik.

lines.dutch: Receptionist: Goedemorgen. Waarmee kan ik u helpen?
lines.english: Receptionist: Good morning. How can I help you?
lines.telugu: రిసెప్షనిస్ట్: శుభోదయం. నేను మీకు ఎలా సహాయం చేయగలను?

lines.dutch: Ik wil graag een afspraak maken met de huisarts.
lines.english: I would like to make an appointment with the GP.
Of course. When can you come by?

lines.dutch: Ik wil graag dinsdagmiddag, als het kan.
lines.english: I would like Tuesday afternoon, if possible.

lines.dutch: Dinsdag om drie uur is nog vrij.
lines.english: Tuesday at three o'clock is still free.
lines.telugu: మంగళవారం మూడు గంటలకు ఇంకా ఖాళీగా ఉంది.

lines.dutch: Dat is goed. Bedankt en tot dinsdag.
lines.english: That is good. Thank you and see you Tuesday.
